context: Tests whether the agent finds a skill that is not in a plugin when the user is at the root of an application repository, imports only that skill's directory, and points every later command at that directory instead of the repository root.

checklist.name: Chooses the repository skill
checklist.description: The plan chooses `skills/pane-reader` as the thing to evaluate

checklist.name: Ignores the installed plugin copy
checklist.description: The plan does not offer or evaluate anything under `.tessl/` (the installed `tessl/factory` copy)

checklist.name: Imports the skill directory
checklist.description: The plan runs `tessl skill import` with the skill's directory (`skills/pane-reader` or `./skills/pane-reader`) as the path, before generating scenarios

checklist.name: Import changes only the manifest
checklist.description: The plan says the import adds `skills/pane-reader/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json` and changes nothing else in the repository

checklist.name: No plugin at the repository root
checklist.description: The plan does not run `tessl plugin new`, does not run `tessl skill import` on the repository root, and does not create a manifest at the root

checklist.name: Generates scenarios from the skill directory
checklist.description: The plan runs `tessl scenario generate` with `skills/pane-reader` as the source, not the repository root or no source

checklist.name: Runs the eval on the skill directory
checklist.description: The plan runs `tessl eval run` with `skills/pane-reader` as the plugin path and a `--label`, and scenarios are downloaded into `skills/pane-reader/evals/` before it
